<!--
For larger architectural ideas, consider opening a Discussion first —
they're better for design conversation than Issues.

If what you want is for qana to ACCEPT a grammar it currently refuses,
please read the "envelope" section of CONTRIBUTING.md first. That request
is welcome, but it is a question about where the envelope is drawn, not a
missing feature — and it belongs in a Discussion.
-->

## What problem are you trying to solve?

<!--
Describe the language or tooling you're trying to build. "I want feature X"
is harder to evaluate than "I'm trying to express Y and the grammar surface
makes it awkward."
-->

## Proposed solution

<!-- What the feature would look like from a grammar author's perspective. -->

## What guarantee does it interact with?

<!--
Optional but valuable. qana derives incrementality, editor intelligence and
losslessness from the envelope's constraints. If your proposal touches one
of those, say which — it usually determines whether the answer is "yes",
"yes but differently", or "that is what the envelope excludes, and here is
why".
-->

## Alternatives considered

<!--
Other approaches you've thought about. Knowing what you've ruled out is as
informative as knowing what you want.
-->

## Additional context

<!-- Links to related issues, prior art in other parser generators. -->
